title: Uniqueness and nonuniqueness for mean field equations with multiple singularities on flat tori
summary: We study mean field equations with multiple positive singularities on flat tori. We establish a uniform uniqueness criterion in terms of the total singular mass and the scale-invariant spectral quantity $λ_1(\mathbb T)|\mathbb T|$, where $λ_1(\mathbb T)$ denotes the first positive eigenvalue of the Laplacian. Combining nodal-set analysis for Jacobi fields with a cylindrical Alexandrov--Bol type inequality and sharp small-capacity asymptotics, we obtain the optimal leading coefficient $8/π^2$ in the total-mass uniqueness bound as $λ_1(\mathbb T)|\mathbb T|\to0$.
